When I was actually clinically depressed, fucking nothing. The two times since then that I've felt dramatically sad and hopeless for awhile, which is still incomparable to actual long-term depression but might be closer to what you're referring to, I think of the things I'm grateful for. Then I imagine people around the world who don't have those things and how sad they must be, and how strong they are if they aren't sad. I make up stories about them, imagine them struggling everyday, really empathize with them, for quite awhile. The mixture of gratitude, imagination, and thinking about others who have no relation to my self-absorbed stupid depressed self helps. Then maybe you'll muster up enough of something to make yourself to go see a friend or do anything other than lay in bed.
